name: @graphcompose-ai-flow/asset-resolver
description: Resolve icon and font design assets for a GraphCompose-AI-Flow revision. Reads asset-request.json, downloads icons from iconify.design, validates Google Fonts (bundled in GraphCompose or marked for manual drop), and writes assets-manifest.json plus assets/{icons,fonts}/ files under the revision directory.

scripts.lint: node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/iconify.mjs && node --check src/google-fonts.mjs && node --check src/playwright-fallback.mjs && node --check src/plan-reader.mjs
